findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_content_calendar, record_content, list_feed, get_seo, get_claims, get_standup, get_move, dismiss_gap, propose_move · Private data: record_content, list_kb_pages, get_kb_page, record_claim, set_voice_axes, accept_move, ship_move, set_output_status, disconnect_connection, record_insight · Public sink: get_visibility, record_claim, set_voice_axes, get_move, undo_move, set_loop_autonomy, propose_move · Destructive: whoami, get_enrollment, get_snapshot, refresh_scan, replenish_feed, run_loop, set_loop_cadence, set_scan_config, create_checkout, create_topup, disconnect_connection, track_prompt, untrack_prompt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_content_calendar, record_content, list_feed, get_seo, get_claims, get_standup, get_move, dismiss_gap, propose_move · Private data: record_content, list_kb_pages, get_kb_page, record_claim, set_voice_axes, accept_move, ship_move, set_output_status, disconnect_connection, record_insight · Public sink: get_visibility, record_claim, set_voice_axes, get_move, undo_move, set_loop_autonomy, propose_move · Destructive: whoami, get_enrollment, get_snapshot, refresh_scan, replenish_feed, run_loop, set_loop_cadence, set_scan_config, create_checkout, create_topup, disconnect_connection, track_prompt, untrack_prompt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
